verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.contasimples.com returns HTTP 200 with a structured index pointing to per-section index files. The docs also state that every page is available as Markdown via a .md suffix or an Accept: text/markdown header, which gives agents clean, agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no evidence of a consolidated full-content file such as llms-full.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Every page is also available as Markdown: add .md to its URL, or request it with an Accept: text/markdown header.
